title: WEDNESDAY POSTERIOR
subtitle: WEDNESDAY. GLUTE BRIDGES, SINGLE-LEG HINGE BALANCE, REVERSE LUNGES, STAIR HAMSTRING STRETCH, FIGURE-FOUR, CAT-COW. THE BACK OF THE BODY DOES THE WORK, THEN WE LET IT BREATHE.

script.welcome: WEDNESDAY, GRIMES. POSTERIOR DAY. SIXTEEN MINUTES. THAT MEANS YOUR BACKSIDE, AND YES, IT HAS BEEN SAT ON ALL WEEK. WE WAKE IT UP, WE TEST YOUR BALANCE, THEN WE STRETCH THE HAMSTRINGS YOU FORGOT YOU OWNED. ON YOUR FEET. NOW.
script.rest: REST. THAT IS NOT AN INVITATION TO SIT BACK DOWN AT THE DESK.
script.lastSet: LAST ONE. FINISH IT LIKE YOU MEAN IT. EYES ON YOU.
script.complete: DISMISSED. GLUTES AWAKE, BALANCE TESTED, HAMSTRINGS AND HIPS OPENED. GNOCCHI TONIGHT, GRIMES. ONE SENSIBLE PLATE, HEAVY ON THE SAUSAGE AND PEPPERS, NOT A SECOND TRIP. PROTEIN AT LUNCH. I'M WATCHING.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGES
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK, KNEES BENT, FEET FLAT AND HIP-WIDTH, HEELS A HAND'S LENGTH FROM THE BUM. PRESS THROUGH THE HEELS, SQUEEZE THE GLUTES, LIFT HIPS UNTIL KNEES, HIPS AND SHOULDERS LINE UP. PAUSE ONE SECOND AT THE TOP. LOWER SLOW. NO ARCHING THE LOW BACK.
exercises.speakStart: GLUTE BRIDGES. THREE SETS OF TWELVE. FLAT ON YOUR BACK, FEET DOWN, DRIVE THROUGH THE HEELS AND SQUEEZE AT THE TOP LIKE YOU'RE HOLDING A FIFTY PENCE PIECE. PAUSE, THEN LOWER SLOW. THAT CHAIR HAS FLATTENED YOUR ARSE, GRIMES. WE ARE REINFLATING IT.
exercises.speakDone: BRIDGES DONE. GLUTES REPORTING FOR DUTY. GOOD.

exercises.name: SINGLE-LEG HINGE BALANCE
exercises.cue: STAND TALL NEAR A WALL OR CHAIR FOR A FINGERTIP IF NEEDED. SOFT KNEE ON THE STANDING LEG. HINGE AT THE HIPS, CHEST FORWARD, FREE LEG REACHING BACK, BODY LIKE A SEESAW. HIPS SQUARE TO THE FLOOR. HOLD ONE SECOND, RETURN TALL. SLOW.
exercises.speakStart: SINGLE LEG HINGE. BALANCE WORK. TWO ROUNDS, FIVE EACH LEG. SOFT KNEE, TIP FORWARD FROM THE HIPS, BACK LEG REACHES AWAY. HIPS LEVEL. A FINGERTIP ON THE WALL IS LEGAL. A WHOLE HAND IS CHEATING AND I WILL SEE IT.
exercises.speakDone: HINGE DONE. STEADIER THAN LAST WEEK. GOOD.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGES
exercises.cue: STAND TALL, HANDS ON HIPS OR A FINGERTIP ON THE CHAIR. STEP ONE FOOT BACK, LOWER THE BACK KNEE TOWARD THE FLOOR, FRONT KNEE OVER THE ANKLE. CHEST UP. DRIVE THROUGH THE FRONT HEEL TO STAND. ALTERNATE OR DO ALL ONE SIDE FIRST.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO ROUNDS, SIX EACH LEG. STEP BACK, KNEE DOWN SOFT, CHEST PROUD, PUSH THROUGH THE FRONT HEEL. NOT A RACE. A WOBBLE IS FINE. A COLLAPSE IS PAPERWORK.

exercises.name: STAIR HAMSTRING STRETCH
exercises.cue: HEEL ON THE BOTTOM STAIR, LEG STRAIGHT BUT NOT LOCKED, TOES UP. STANDING KNEE SOFT. HINGE FORWARD FROM THE HIPS WITH A LONG FLAT BACK UNTIL YOU FEEL THE BACK OF THE THIGH. NO ROUNDING, NO BOUNCING. HOLD 30, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: STAIR HAMSTRING STRETCH. TWO ROUNDS, THIRTY SECONDS EACH LEG. HEEL ON THE BOTTOM STAIR, TOES UP, FLAT BACK, TIP FORWARD FROM THE HIPS. NO BOUNCING. THIS IS A STRETCH, NOT A DISCO.

exercises.name: FIGURE-FOUR HIP STRETCH
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK OR SEATED ON THE CHAIR. CROSS ONE ANKLE OVER THE OPPOSITE KNEE. ON THE FLOOR, DRAW THE BOTTOM KNEE TOWARD THE CHEST; ON THE CHAIR, SIT TALL AND HINGE FORWARD. FEEL IT IN THE OUTER HIP AND GLUTE. BREATHE. HOLD 30, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: FIGURE FOUR. TWO ROUNDS, THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. ANKLE OVER KNEE, PULL IN OR LEAN FORWARD TILL THE HIP SAYS HELLO. BREATHE INTO IT. YOU'RE ALLOWED TO GROAN. QUIETLY.

exercises.name: CAT-COW
exercises.cue: ALL FOURS, HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. INHALE: DROP THE BELLY, LIFT CHEST AND TAILBONE, EYES FORWARD (COW). EXHALE: ROUND THE SPINE UP, TUCK CHIN AND TAILBONE (CAT). SLOW, ONE BREATH EACH WAY.
exercises.speakStart: CAT COW. TWO ROUNDS OF EIGHT. YOUR FAVOURITE, GRIMES, DON'T PRETEND OTHERWISE. BREATHE IN, BELLY DOWN, CHEST UP. BREATHE OUT, ROUND THE BACK LIKE AN ANGRY CAT. SLOW.
exercises.speakDone: SPINE OILED. THAT IS WEDNESDAY DONE. DISMISSED.
